title: senecio polypodioides
intro: Senecio polypodioides, commonly known as Flaxweed or Life Plant, is a plant species that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is known for its various health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Senecio polypodioides include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids and diterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
